Healthy adults viewed a movie excerpt with coded social interaction events; group-level whole-brain univariate F-test across interaction types captures task-evoked social interaction processing broadly.

Coded events include verbal and non-verbal communicative interactions in a naturalistic movie; whole-brain group-level F-test across interaction types reflects processing of socially communicative cues (speech/gesture/interaction).
